title: Manage Contract Accounts
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM
The contract account is locked for the business transaction selected either for a limited or unlimited amount of time, depending on
the lock reason.

Manage Contract Accounts

The Manage Contract Accounts (F5474) app provides a central entry point for contract account maintenance.

Key Features

You can use this app to do the following:

e Display a list of contract accounts

Filter the list according to your needs, for example, by business partner and company code
e Display a contract account by clicking on it
e Change a contract account

To change a contract account, select the desired contract account in the list and press Change. This takes you to the app
for changing contract accounts.

e Create contract accounts

To create a new contract account, press Create. This takes you to the app for creating contract accounts.

1 Note

From the Manage Contract Accounts app, you can access the following transactions:

e Create Contract Account (transaction CAA1)
e Change Contract Account (transaction CAA2)

e Display Contract Account (transaction CAA3)

Implementation Information

In the SAP Fiori Apps Reference Library, see the details for the Manage Contract Accounts app.

Related Information
